source.authority: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, VIEWPORT entity

fields.group_68: -1 (on but off-screen or inactive), 0 (off), or positive (on and active; stacking order)

change.behavior: DRW_Viewport::validateDxf rejects vpstatus values below -1 and shadePlotMode values above 3. The DWG wire-width validation and DXF parseCode assignments are unchanged.

coverage: ASCII and Binary generated DXF read/write/readback for statuses -1, 0, 1, and the signed-16-bit maximum 32767, crossed with all shade-plot modes 0 through 3
The group-68 parser accepts -2 and the group-170 parser accepts 4 as observed values while typed DXF validation rejects each
ASCII and Binary strict output for each invalid value fails without replacing a pre-existing destination
The same writer succeeds after correcting group 68 to -1 or group 170 to 3, and typed readback retains the corrected value

limits: This establishes documented field-domain admission and codec behavior only; it does not qualify viewport rendering or full-application semantics.
The VIEWPORT group-91 representation/reference conflict remains unresolved and output-refused pending an eligible native ASCII/Binary witness.
